verdict.rationale: three.js ships its own first-party addons: GLTFLoader for importing ready-made models, OrbitControls and TransformControls, and SVG/CSS3D renderers. It also offers an editor and a devtools extension, and its 12M+ weekly npm downloads show a very large user base. However, nothing in the evidence shows an asset store or marketplace of ready-made models, or a third-party plugin ecosystem. Missing for 10: an asset store or model marketplace, evidence of a third-party plugin or package ecosystem, and independent corroboration of the asset workflow.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins

citations.quote: SVG and CSS3D renderers are also available as addons.
the public npm downloads API reports 12,206,532 weekly downloads
